text: The 2025 loss area is classified as native forest by the Uruguay Ministry of Livestock, Agriculture and Fisheries (MGAP) National forest cartography version 2021. This source provides a detailed map distinguishing native forest from planted forest. The MGAP 2021 map indicates that the event area of 13.5 ha consists of 13.1 ha of native forest and 0.4 ha outside mapped forest, with no planted forest present.
